title: Transaction whose source is a muxed account with muxed ID 0
why: Muxed ID 0 is a real ID: the source is the M address of the account with ID 0, not the plain G address. Readers that use 0 as 'no muxed ID' drop the M form, and readers that key on the M form split one account into two.

variants.notes: Real pubnet ledger with 274 transactions, 72 of them failed; this entry's pattern is transaction 135 in apply order (position 187 in the v0 transaction set). The lake object was rewritten by stellar-core 23.0.1, so the Protocol 17 ledger carries TransactionMeta v4 with backfilled fee events.

values.note: The envelope's source is the M strkey of key 8348f290...cb41 with muxed ID 0 (the last 8 payload bytes are zero).
The meta names the base account: fee and sequence number are charged to the G account.
The backfilled fee event names the base G address; the muxed ID is not in any event.

notes: Participants carry muxed_id "0" and the M form: a reader that reports a muxed ID for this source must report 0, and one that reports none passes (rule P-2). A reader that stores only the M form fails P-3. No known divergence is recorded: none has been executed against this ledger.
